gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have pathologically proven diagnosis of high grade (aka grade III or IV) glioma that has progressed on bevacizumab (anaplastic astrocytoma, anaplastic oligodendroglioma, glioblastoma, gliosarcoma, H3K27M mutant glioma).

candidate_evidence.quote: The goal of this interventional study is to evaluate the efficacy of APG-157 in combination with Bevacizumab in subjects with recurrent high-grade glioma.
The participants will receive APG-157 daily; and continue to receive Bevacizumab as standard of care.

candidate_flag.reason: APG-157 is not described in the record; if it is a botanical/curcumin-type product without medicine status it could fall under the supplement exclusion rather than be a pharmacological candidate.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Treatment of Patients With Recurrent High-Grade Glioma With APG-157 and Bevacizumab

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Measure the amount of APG-157 components in the blood in the presence of bevacizumab

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: optionally serum changes in VEGF and HIF-1 alpha, if the study shows preliminary indication of efficacy

role_evidence.quote: The participants will receive APG-157 daily by taking two pastilles in their mouth at around breakfast, lunch and dinner time (total of six pastilles per day).

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational botanical drug (oral pastille; believed to be a Curcuma longa-derived multicomponent product)

flag.reason: Nature of APG-157 not stated in the record; candidate status depends on whether it is a medicine or a supplement-type botanical.

role_evidence.quote: The participants will continue to receive Bevacizumab as standard of care.

coder_notes: Bevacizumab is not a registered intervention but every patient continues it as standard of care, so listed as soc_backbone. Optional serum VEGF and HIF-1 alpha changes are planned but not explicitly linked to APG-157's target, so target_engagement coded unclear; not listed as tumour biomarkers because they are serum markers. H3K27M mutant glioma is one of the eligible histologies, not an entry requirement, so not listed as a biomarker. cns5 historical because conditions use 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' and grade III/IV without IDH.
